drafts.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Senior Business Analyst position at Example Enterprise Solutions.

With 10 years of experience across financial services, telecommunications, and cloud software, I have developed expertise in business analysis, requirements engineering, process modeling, and Agile delivery.

In my previous roles, I documented functional requirements, modeled business processes using BPMN, prepared user stories and use cases, and coordinated integration testing and UAT. I have also applied SQL to data validation and reporting and analyzed REST API integration scenarios.

I am particularly interested in opportunities to improve business processes through data-driven analysis and responsible AI-assisted workflows.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience aligns with your team's needs.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan
